cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/dev/stress4.py << 'PYEOF'
import ctypes, json, sys, time, itertools, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job

# maximal DFS tree with a 65536-window universe and 10000 training rows
fields = [{'name': 'x', 'type': 'count', 'domain': list(range(32))},
          {'name': 'y', 'type': 'count', 'domain': [0, 1]}]
preds = [{'kind': 'all', 'field': 'x', 'op': 'ne', 'value': v} for v in range(32)]
rows = [list(t) for t in itertools.combinations(range(32), 3)]
rng = random.Random(3)
train = []
i = 0
while len(train) < 10000:
    t = rows[i % len(rows)]
    train.append([t, [rng.choice([0, 1])]])
    i += 1
queries = [{'target': [rng.randrange(3), rng.choice(['x', 'y'])],
            'prefix': rng.choice(['', '1', '12', '3', '31']),
            'fixed': [{'ref': [0, 'x'], 'value': rng.randrange(32)}]} for _ in range(64)]
job = {'fields': fields, 'slots': 3, 'predicates': preds, 'width': 4, 'train': train,
       'approved': [], 'queries': queries}
t0 = time.time()
out = compile_job(job)
print(f'universe 65536 DFS: {time.time()-t0:.2f}s rules {len(out["rules"])} answers {len(out["answers"])}')

# same, but with y-predicates mixed in to create surviving rules and approvals
preds2 = preds + [{'kind': 'any', 'field': 'y', 'op': 'eq', 'value': 1},
                  {'kind': 'all', 'field': 'y', 'op': 'eq', 'value': 0}]
job2 = dict(job)
job2['predicates'] = preds2
t0 = time.time()
out2 = compile_job(job2)
print(f'with y predicates: {time.time()-t0:.2f}s rules {len(out2["rules"])}')
job2b = dict(job2)
job2b['approved'] = [r['clause'] for r in out2['rules'][:256]]
t0 = time.time()
out2b = compile_job(job2b)
print(f'with approvals: {time.time()-t0:.2f}s active {len(out2b["active"])} answers {len(out2b["answers"])}')
print('out bytes', len(json.dumps(out2b)))
PYEOF
